definition_zh: 不情愿；勉强；迟疑；磁阻
definition_en: unwillingness to do something, shown as hesitation or resistance
core_image: 一扇门被推开一条缝，又被里面的人轻轻推回去半寸
scene: 谈判桌两边都摊开了文件，问到她是否接受这个日期时，她先看了一眼同事，又把笔放回桌上。 Her reluctance to commit to a date slowed the whole meeting.
sceneCN: 这里 reluctance 指「不愿作出承诺的迟疑」（第 8 个义项：外交场合不愿表态或让步）；句意为她不愿敲定日期，拖慢了整场会议。

pos.zh: 不情愿；勉强；迟疑；磁阻（不可数）

forms.label: 不可数名词（通常无复数）

derivatives.zh: 不情愿地（由 reluctant 加副词后缀，把迟疑转成动作方式）
不情愿（由 reluctant 加旧式名词后缀，与常见名词后缀同源的罕用变体）
磁阻率（由 reluctance「磁阻」加表性质的名词后缀，转入物理学量）
磁阻电机（由「磁阻」与「电动机」复合而成，指利用磁阻变化产生转矩的电机）

senses.title: Unwillingness to act
senses.definition: the state of not wanting to do something and hesitating before it
senses.definitionCN: 不想做某事、行动前犹豫的状态
senses.example: Her reluctance was clear from the way she kept checking the time.
senses.exampleCN: 她不停看时间的样子，清楚显出了不情愿。
senses.why: The Latin verb is a wrestling back; the noun names that backward pull before any action begins.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词是「反着摔」；这个名词指的就是行动开始之前的那股向后拉力。

senses.title: With reluctance
senses.definition: used in the phrase with reluctance to show that an act is done grudgingly
senses.definitionCN: 用于表示「勉强地」的固定说法，说明动作是勉强做出来的
senses.example: He signed the form with reluctance and said nothing.
senses.exampleCN: 他勉强签了表，一句话也没说。
senses.why: The phrase puts the inner no beside the outer act, so the reader sees both at once.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语把内心的「不」放在外在动作旁边，让读者同时看见两者。

senses.title: Reluctance to admit or reveal
senses.definition: hesitation to state a fact, especially one that costs face or safety
senses.definitionCN: 不愿说出某个事实，尤其当它会伤面子或带来风险时
senses.example: The witness's reluctance to name names frustrated the inquiry.
senses.exampleCN: 证人不愿说出名字，让调查很受挫。
senses.why: Speech is a form of handing something over; refusing to speak keeps the fact inside the hand.
senses.whyCN: 说话是把东西交出去的一种方式；拒绝开口，就是把事实继续握在手里。

senses.title: Reluctance to spend or part with
senses.definition: unwillingness to give up money, possessions or resources
senses.definitionCN: 不愿交出金钱、财物或资源
senses.example: The company showed a familiar reluctance to invest in training.
senses.exampleCN: 公司在培训投入上表现出一种熟悉的不情愿。
senses.why: The wrestling match moves to the wallet: the hand holds the coin, and release feels like loss.
senses.whyCN: 摔跤挪到了钱包上：手握着硬币，松开就像损失。

senses.title: Magnetic reluctance
senses.definition: in physics, the resistance of a magnetic circuit to magnetic flux
senses.definitionCN: 物理学中，磁路对磁通量的阻力
senses.example: Iron has much lower magnetic reluctance than air.
senses.exampleCN: 铁的磁阻比空气低得多。
senses.why: Physics borrows the everyday image of resistance and gives it a precise measurable form.
senses.whyCN: 物理学借走了日常的「阻力」意象，把它变成一个可精确测量的量。

senses.title: Reluctance motor
senses.definition: in electrical engineering, a motor that produces torque by exploiting changing magnetic reluctance
senses.definitionCN: 电气工程中，利用磁阻变化产生转矩的电动机
senses.example: The workshop replaced its old drive with a reluctance motor.
senses.exampleCN: 车间用一台磁阻电机替换了旧驱动装置。
senses.why: A technical term turns the physics quantity into a machine: the resistance itself is made to do work.
senses.whyCN: 一个技术术语把物理量变成了机器：阻力本身被用来做功。

senses.title: Resistance to change
senses.definition: in organizations, the unwillingness of a group to accept a new practice
senses.definitionCN: 组织里，群体不愿接受新做法的状态
senses.example: Management underestimated the staff's reluctance to change.
senses.exampleCN: 管理层低估了员工对变革的抵触。
senses.why: A group can hold a habit the way a hand holds an object; change asks the group to let go.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体可以像手握物件那样握着习惯；变革就是要求群体松手。

senses.title: Diplomatic reluctance
senses.definition: in diplomacy, unwillingness to commit, promise or give ground
senses.definitionCN: 外交场合中，不愿承诺、表态或让步
senses.example: Her reluctance to commit to a date slowed the whole meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 她不愿敲定日期，拖慢了整场会议。
senses.why: A state, like a person, can keep its hand closed until the terms improve; reluctance is that pause in public.
senses.whyCN: 一个国家也像一个人，可以在条件变好之前一直握着手不松开；不情愿就是公开场合里的那阵停顿。

intro.en: Reluctance appeared in English in the 1640s, first as 'the act of struggling against', later as 'unwillingness'. It grew from the Latin wrestling verb reluctari, either through the old English verb reluct or directly from the Latin noun endings.
intro.cn: reluctance 在十七世纪四十年代出现在英语里，最初指「抗争的动作」，后来指「不情愿」。它从拉丁语摔跤动词 reluctari 生长出来，可能经由古老的英语动词 reluct，也可能直接借拉丁名词词尾。

items.en: Reluctari meant 'to struggle against, resist, make opposition', built from re- 'against' and luctari 'to wrestle'.
items.cn: reluctari 意为「抗争、抵抗、作出反对」，由表示「反对」的前缀与 luctari「摔跤」构成。

items.en: The Latin ending -antia formed abstract nouns of state, and its French descendant -ance is the ending English borrowed for nouns such as reluctance.
items.cn: 那个拉丁词尾构成表示状态的抽象名词，它的法语后裔就是英语借来构成 reluctance 这类名词的词尾。

items.en: A fifteenth-century English verb reluct 'to strive or rebel against' is recorded, and the noun reluctance is usually explained as its abstract form with -ance.
items.cn: 英语里记录过一个十五世纪动词 reluct「抗争、反叛」，名词 reluctance 通常被解释为它加名词词尾构成的抽象形式。

items.en: By the 1640s reluctance named the act of struggling; by the 1660s it had shifted to the inner unwillingness that we usually mean today.
items.cn: 到十七世纪四十年代，reluctance 指抗争的动作；到六十年代，它转向我们今天通常指的内心的不情愿。

items.en: Modern technical English added magnetic reluctance and the reluctance motor, turning the old idea of resistance into a measurable physical quantity and a machine.
items.cn: 现代技术英语又加上磁阻与磁阻电机，把古老的「阻力」观念变成可测量的物理量和一台机器。

items.en: Source uncertain: whether a Latin noun reluctantia was ever in common use is uncertain; the safe account is the English formation with -ance. The deeper origin of luctari is also unsettled, with reconstructed forms and the wrestling image competing.
items.cn: 来源不确定：拉丁名词 reluctantia 是否曾通行，无法确定；稳妥的说法是英语用名词词尾构成。luctari 更深来源同样没有定论，重构形式与摔跤意象两种解释并存。

note.en: The first group holds forms from the same Latin wrestling family; the second holds near neighbours that also describe a no, but with a different source or strength.
note.cn: 第一组是同一个拉丁「摔跤」词族的形式；第二组是同为拒绝、但来源或力度不同的近义词。

entries.definition: The adjective that describes the person; reluctance names the state behind it.
entries.definitionCN: 描写人的形容词；reluctance 指它背后的状态。

entries.definition: The adverb that describes how the unwilling action is carried out.
entries.definitionCN: 描写不情愿的动作如何执行的副词。

entries.definition: The old English verb 'to strive against', now archaic; it is the cousin from which the noun is often derived.
entries.definitionCN: 古英语动词「抗争」，现已废弃；名词常被认为由它派生而来。

entries.definition: A flat lack of willingness, without the wrestling image of a force pulling back.
entries.definitionCN: 平直地缺乏意愿，没有那股向后拉的摔跤意象。

entries.definition: A pause caused by uncertainty; reluctance is a pause caused by opposition.
entries.definitionCN: 因没把握而停顿；reluctance 是因反对而停顿。

entries.definition: Active pushing back, often organized and public; it is stronger and more external than reluctance.
entries.definitionCN: 主动顶回去，常是有组织、公开的；比 reluctance 更强、更外在。

entries.definition: A strong dislike that makes one turn away; the feeling is sharper than mere reluctance.
entries.definitionCN: 强烈的厌恶，使人转身避开；比单纯的不情愿更尖锐。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real fixed phrases and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词语素、真实固定搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: re- (against) + luctari (to wrestle) + -ance (state): the noun is 'the state of wrestling back'.
normal.cn: 表示「反对」的前缀加 luctari（摔跤）再加表示状态的名词词尾：这个名词就是「反着摔的状态」。

normal.en: Latin lucta 'a wrestling match' keeps the body picture: two forces locked, neither giving way.
normal.cn: 拉丁 lucta「一场摔跤」保留了身体画面：两股力量锁住，谁也不让。

normal.en: The family runs reluctant, reluctance, reluctantly, reluctancy, reluctivity.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 reluctant、reluctance、reluctantly、reluctancy、reluctivity。

normal.en: Fixed phrases show the pull: with reluctance, reluctance to do, show reluctance, overcome reluctance.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出那股拉力：勉强地、不愿做、表现出不情愿、克服不情愿。

normal.en: Physics reuses the word as magnetic reluctance, the resistance of a magnetic circuit.
normal.cn: 物理学把这个词再用一次，造出「磁阻」这一术语，指磁路对磁通的阻力。

abstract.en: Picture a door pushed open a crack and then eased back half an inch from inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门被推开一条缝，又被里面的人轻轻推回半寸。

abstract.en: Picture a hand that will not open while the coin is still inside it.
abstract.cn: 想象一只不肯张开的手，硬币还在里面。

abstract.en: Picture a signature that takes three tries before the pen touches paper.
abstract.cn: 想象一个签名，笔尖碰纸之前试了三次。

examples.en: She agreed to the plan with obvious reluctance.
examples.cn: 她显然很勉强地同意了这个计划。

examples.en: The reluctance of investors to commit capital delayed the project.
examples.cn: 投资者不愿投入资金，拖慢了项目。

examples.en: Engineers measured the magnetic reluctance of the new core.
examples.cn: 工程师测量了新磁芯的磁阻。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞拉克坦斯」—— 被拉去摔跤的人一步三回头，浑身写着不情愿 → reluctance 不情愿；勉强

root: 拉丁 reluctari「抗争」的名词化：表示「反对」的前缀加 luctari「搏斗」，lucta 指「摔跤」；英语中或经由古动词 reluct 加名词后缀，或直接借拉丁词尾构成。拉丁名词 reluctantia 是否通行不确定，luctari 更深来源亦无定论。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the same backward pull: first the inner no, then the grudging act, then the refusal to reveal, spend, or move. The same image later becomes magnetic resistance, a motor, an organization's inertia, and a state's silence at the table.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一股向后的拉力展开：先是内心的「不」，再是勉强的动作，然后是不肯透露、不肯花钱、不肯挪动。同一个意象后来变成磁阻、一台电机、一个组织的惰性，以及一个国家在谈判桌前的沉默。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a force that keeps pulling the hand back.
core.cn: 核心意象：一股始终把手往回拉的力量。

branches.en: THE CORE: the inner no appears before any action, as a general state of hesitation.
branches.cn: 核心：内心的「不」先于任何行动出现，表现为整体的迟疑状态。

branches.en: THE NO BESIDE THE ACT: with reluctance lets the reader see the unwilling act and the unwilling feeling together.
branches.cn: 「不」与动作并置：表示「勉强地」的固定说法让读者同时看见勉强的动作和不情愿的感受。

branches.en: TWO THINGS KEPT: facts stay unspoken and money stays unspent; both are forms of withholding.
branches.cn: 两样被握住的东西：事实不说出口，钱不花出去；两者都是「扣住不放」。

branches.en: THE IMAGE MADE TECHNICAL: magnetic reluctance measures resistance in a circuit, and the reluctance motor makes it do work.
branches.cn: 意象技术化：磁阻测量磁路中的阻力，磁阻电机则让这份阻力做功。

branches.en: THE NO WRIT LARGE: a group resists a new practice, and a state refuses to commit at the table.
branches.cn: 放大后的「不」：一个群体抵触新做法，一个国家在谈判桌前拒绝承诺。

intro.en: Reluctance is a Latin-derived noun built from a prefix of opposition, a wrestling root and a noun ending of state; the family stays readable piece by piece.
intro.cn: reluctance 是拉丁来源的名词，由表示反对的前缀、表示摔跤的词根和表示状态的名词词尾构成；整个词族仍可逐块读出。

latinIntro.en: The Latin side is small: a verb for wrestling, a verb for wrestling back, and a noun for the match. The abstract noun ending came through French into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁这一侧不大：一个摔跤动词、一个反着摔的动词、一个表示摔跤本身的名称。抽象名词词尾则经法语进入英语。

items.example: The prefix reverses the direction of the struggle.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把搏斗的方向反过来。

items.example: The root keeps the body in the word.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根把身体留在了词里。

items.meaning: the ending that names a state or quality
items.meaningCN: 指状态或性质的名词词尾
items.example: The ending turns the struggle into a state.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾把搏斗变成一种状态。
她的不情愿弥漫了整个房间。
那名不情愿的证人最后才开口。
磁阻率描述了这种材料的性质。

items.meaning: a motor driven by changing magnetic reluctance
items.meaningCN: 靠磁阻变化驱动的电机
items.example: The plant installed a reluctance motor.
items.exampleCN: 工厂安装了一台磁阻电机。

items.meaningCN: 抗争（已废弃的英语动词）
items.example: Reluct survives only in historical dictionaries.
items.exampleCN: reluct 如今只留在历史词典里。

definition_zh: 和解；调和；使一致；对账；使顺从
definition_en: to bring people, ideas or records back into agreement after a difference
core_image: 两本账簿摊在桌上，数字一格一格对上，最后一行终于写出同一个合计
scene: 交报表前，她把发票、银行流水和台账逐笔核对，找出差了的那两笔。 She reconciled the two records before submitting the report.
sceneCN: 这里指把两套记录核对到一致（第 4 个义项：核对账目使相符）；句意为她在交报表前把两套记录对平了。图中可辨识物件：摊开的账簿、逐行核对的笔迹、写出同一合计的最后一行。

derivatives.zh: 由该动词加表示动作结果的名词尾构成，义为「和解；调和；对账」
由该动词加表示倾向的形容词尾构成，义为「和解性的」
由该动词加表示施动者的名词尾构成，义为「调停者」
由否定前缀加「可调和的」构成，义为「不可调和的」
由该动词加已然词尾构成，义为「已和解的；已对平的」

senses.title: To restore a relationship
senses.definition: to bring two people or groups back to friendly relations after a quarrel
senses.definitionCN: 在争吵之后使人或群体重回友好关系
senses.example: The brothers reconciled after the funeral.
senses.exampleCN: 兄弟俩在葬礼之后和解了。
senses.why: The Latin verb meant to bring back together into a council, and that is the human core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「重新召集到一处」，这正是这个词的人情内核。

senses.title: To harmonise ideas
senses.definition: to show that two apparently opposed ideas can both be accepted
senses.definitionCN: 说明两种看似对立的观点可以同时成立
senses.example: The essay reconciles scientific evidence with local belief.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章把科学证据与当地信仰调和起来。
senses.why: Ideas are brought into one council too, and reconciliation is the seating of opponents at one table.
senses.whyCN: 观点也被召进同一个议事厅，调和就是让对手坐到一张桌子旁。

senses.title: To make statements consistent
senses.definition: to make an account agree with the evidence or with another account
senses.definitionCN: 使一种说法与证据或另一种说法相符
senses.example: He could not reconcile his story with the time stamps.
senses.exampleCN: 他无法让自己的说法与时间戳对上。
senses.why: When two accounts disagree, reconciling them means finding the version that satisfies both.
senses.whyCN: 当两份叙述不一致，调和就是找出能同时满足两者的版本。

senses.title: To check financial records
senses.definition: to compare two sets of records and adjust them until they agree
senses.definitionCN: 比较两套记录并调整到相符
senses.example: The clerk reconciled the bank statement with the ledger.
senses.exampleCN: 职员把银行对账单与台账对平了。
senses.why: Accounting turned the council image into two columns that must arrive at one total.
senses.whyCN: 会计把「议事厅」的画面变成两栏必须合成一个总数的数字。

senses.title: To accept something reluctantly
senses.definition: to bring oneself to accept a difficult situation that cannot be changed
senses.definitionCN: 使自己接受一个无法改变的困难处境
senses.example: She reconciled herself to the longer commute.
senses.exampleCN: 她只好接受了更长的通勤。
senses.why: This reflexive use is a private council: the self is brought back into agreement with reality.
senses.whyCN: 这个反身用法是一场私下的议事：自我被重新与现实达成一致。

senses.title: To mediate a dispute
senses.definition: to act as a third party who brings two sides to an agreement
senses.definitionCN: 作为第三方让两边达成一致
senses.example: A retired judge reconciled the neighbours over the boundary.
senses.exampleCN: 一位退休法官就边界纠纷调解了两家邻居。
senses.why: Mediation is the verb performed on behalf of others rather than on oneself.
senses.whyCN: 调解是替别人而不是替自己行使这个动词。

senses.title: To align two datasets
senses.definition: to match two sets of data that use different formats or identifiers
senses.definitionCN: 把格式或标识不同的两套数据匹配起来
senses.example: The team reconciled the sensor logs with the maintenance records.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把传感器日志与维护记录对齐了。
senses.why: Data work inherited the accounting sense: two systems describe one reality and must be made to agree.
senses.whyCN: 数据工作继承了会计义：两个系统描述同一现实，必须被弄成一致。

senses.title: To balance competing needs
senses.definition: to find a practical arrangement that meets two demands at once
senses.definitionCN: 找到同时满足两项要求的实际安排
senses.example: The plan reconciles housing demand with the need for open land.
senses.exampleCN: 这个方案兼顾了住房需求与保留空地的需要。
senses.why: Planning is a council of demands, and reconciling them is what a plan is for.
senses.whyCN: 规划就是各种需求的议事厅，而调和它们正是方案存在的理由。

intro.en: Reconcile comes from Latin reconciliare, to bring together again, from re-, again, and conciliare, to unite, from concilium, an assembly. English took it through French.
intro.cn: 这个词来自拉丁语 reconciliare「重新聚到一起」，由 re-「再」与 conciliare「使联合」构成，而 conciliare 出自 concilium「集会」；英语经法语引入。

items.en: Concilium meant an assembly or council, the gathering of people into one body.
items.cn: 这个词意为集会或议事会，即把人聚成一个整体。

items.en: Conciliare meant to unite or to win over, and it could also mean to procure or to cause.
items.cn: 这个词意为使联合、争取过来，也可指取得或促成。

items.en: The prefix meant again or back, so reconciliare pictured a second gathering after a break.
items.cn: 前缀意为「再、回」，所以这个词的画面是破裂之后的第二次聚集。

items.en: The verb meant to restore to friendship or to bring back into agreement.
items.cn: 这个动词意为恢复友好或使重新一致。

items.en: English adopted the verb through French; the exact first date is uncertain and is usually given only as that century.
items.cn: 英语经法语采用这个动词；确切首见年代不确定，通常只给「十四世纪」。

items.en: Bookkeeping gave the verb its ledger sense, in which the two parties are two sets of figures.
items.cn: 记账给这个动词添了账簿义，其中的「两方」变成了两套数字。

note.en: The first group shares the council stem or looks close; the second group names neighbouring ideas of agreement and settlement.
note.cn: 第一组与「reconcile」共享「集会」词干或只是形近；第二组是与「一致、解决」意思相邻的说法。

entries.definition: The noun for the act of restoring agreement.
entries.definitionCN: 指恢复一致这一行为的名词。

entries.definition: An adjective for differences that cannot be settled.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，指无法调和的分歧。

entries.definition: To win over or pacify, from the same council verb without the re-.
entries.definitionCN: 指安抚、争取，同出「集会」动词，只是没有表示「再」的前缀。

entries.definition: A governing assembly, from the same Latin noun but a different spelling path.
entries.definitionCN: 指议事机构，同出同一拉丁名词，但拼写路径不同。

entries.definition: Advice or a legal adviser, from a different Latin verb meaning to consult.
entries.definitionCN: 指建议或法律顾问，出自另一个表示「商议」的拉丁动词。

entries.definition: To end a dispute by agreement, the plainest verb.
entries.definitionCN: 指以协议结束争端，最朴素的说法。

entries.definition: To fix a problem or decide firmly.
entries.definitionCN: 指解决问题或下定决心。

entries.definition: To make parts fit together without conflict.
entries.definitionCN: 指使各部分协调不冲突。

entries.definition: To stand between two sides and help them agree.
entries.definitionCN: 指居于两方之间帮助他们达成一致。

entries.definition: To bring things into the same line, often used of data.
entries.definitionCN: 指把事物排到同一条线上，常用于数据。

entries.definition: To repair a relationship roughly and quickly.
entries.definitionCN: 指粗略快速地修复关系。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the council inside the word, the accountant's ledger, and the spelling trap with counsel.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用词里的「集会」、会计的账簿，以及 counsel 这个拼写陷阱。

normal.en: Concilium is a council, so reconcile is to call everyone back to one table.
normal.cn: concilium 是议事会，所以这个词就是把人都叫回一张桌子。

normal.en: The re- means again, so the word always implies a break that came first.
normal.cn: re- 意为「再」，所以这个词总暗含先前的一次破裂。

normal.en: Accountants reconcile two sets of figures until they agree.
normal.cn: 会计把两套数字对到相符为止。

normal.en: Reconcile oneself to a hard fact is a private version of the same table.
normal.cn: 让自己接受一个硬事实，是同一张桌子的私下版本。

normal.en: Council is the assembly, counsel is advice, and only council belongs here.
normal.cn: council 是议事机构，counsel 是建议，只有前者与这个词相关。

abstract.en: To reconcile is not to prove one side right; it is to build a table both can sit at.
abstract.cn: 调和不是证明某一方正确，而是造一张双方都能坐下的桌子。

abstract.en: Two true accounts can still disagree, and the work is to find why.
abstract.cn: 两份真实的叙述仍可能对不上，而工作就是找出为什么。

abstract.en: The hardest reconciliation is the one a person performs with a fact that will not move.
abstract.cn: 最难的和解，是一个人跟一个不会改变的事实之间达成的那个。

examples.en: The two countries reconciled after years of frozen relations.
examples.cn: 多年关系冻结之后，两国和解了。

examples.en: It is hard to reconcile such a claim with the published data.
examples.cn: 这样的说法很难与已发表的数据相符。

examples.en: Please reconcile the invoice total with the purchase order.
examples.cn: 请把发票总额与采购订单核对一致。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「瑞康赛尔」——两本账簿摊开，末行写出同一个数：调和、对账

root: 拉丁语 concilium「集会」→ conciliare「使联合」→ reconciliare「重新聚到一起」（re-「再」）；英语十四世纪经法语引入。与 counsel「建议」不同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses all seat two parties at one table: people, ideas, statements, records, the self, a dispute, datasets and competing needs.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项都在把两方请到同一张桌子：人、观点、说法、账目、自我、争端、数据集与冲突的需求。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two ledgers lie open, line by line is matched, and one total finally appears at the bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：两本账簿摊开，逐行对上，最后一行终于写出同一个合计。

branches.en: THE TABLE IS RESET: two people or two groups are brought back to one table, sometimes by a third party.
branches.cn: 桌子被重摆：两个人或两个群体被带回同一桌，有时由第三方促成。

branches.en: THE IDEAS SHARE A ROOM: opposed views or competing needs are arranged so both can stand.
branches.cn: 观点共用一室：对立观点或冲突需求被安排到可以并存。

branches.en: THE STORY IS TESTED: a claim is checked until it fits the evidence.
branches.cn: 说法被检验：一种叙述被核到与证据相符。

branches.en: THE FIGURES MEET: ledgers or datasets are matched until one total appears.
branches.cn: 数字对上：账簿或数据集被匹配到一个总数。

branches.en: THE SELF YIELDS: a person comes to terms with what cannot be changed.
branches.cn: 自我让步：人与无法改变的事达成妥协。

intro.en: Reconcile is a Latin verb of gathering, and its pieces are the prefix of return and the noun for an assembly.
intro.cn: 这是一个表示「聚拢」的拉丁动词，其部件是「返回」的前缀与表示「集会」的名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies concilium, conciliare and reconciliare; the family is well recorded, so no part is marked uncertain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供了 concilium、conciliare、reconciliare；这一族有清楚记录，没有哪一部分标为存疑。

items.example: The noun is the room where the parties meet.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是各方会面的那个房间。

items.example: The verb names the act of bringing together.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词指把人聚到一起的动作。

items.example: It marks the second gathering after a break.
items.exampleCN: 它标出破裂后的第二次聚集。

items.example: The verb carried both the human and the agreement senses.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词兼有人际与一致两种意义。

items.example: The noun supplied the English word for the process.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词提供了英语中表示过程的名词。

items.example: It forms irreconcilable with an assimilated r.
items.exampleCN: 它与同化的 r 一起构成 irreconcilable。

items.example: It forms the adjective for what can be settled.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示「可调和的」形容词。

definition_zh: 泊位；停泊地；（车、船上的）卧铺；安全距离；（v.）停泊
definition_en: a place where a ship moors, a sleeping place on a ship or train, or a safe distance; as a verb, to moor
core_image: 港口里那条系着缆绳、正好容纳一条船的水位
scene: 缆绳抛上岸，船长把船稳稳靠进标好的空位。 The harbourmaster guided the ferry into its berth.
sceneCN: 这里 berth 是「泊位、停泊位」（第 1 个义项：船在港内的固定位置）；句意是港务长引导渡轮驶入指定泊位。

senses.title: A place for a ship to moor
senses.definition: a space in a harbour where a ship can be tied up
senses.definitionCN: 港内供船只系缆停靠的位置
senses.example: The harbourmaster guided the ferry into its berth.
senses.exampleCN: 港务长引导渡轮驶入指定泊位。
senses.why: The word grew from bearing, the room a ship needs to lie at ease.
senses.whyCN: 该词由「容纳的空间」义发展而来，指船安放所需的余地。

senses.title: A sleeping place on a ship or train
senses.definition: a built-in bed in a ship's cabin or a railway carriage
senses.definitionCN: 船舱或火车车厢内的固定床铺
senses.example: He climbed into the upper berth as the train rolled out.
senses.exampleCN: 火车启动时他爬上了上铺。
senses.why: A ship's resting place became a traveller's resting place.
senses.whyCN: 「船的安放之处」转为「旅人的安睡之处」。

senses.title: A safe distance
senses.definition: enough space to keep clear of danger, as in give a wide berth
senses.definitionCN: 与危险保持的充分间距，如 give a wide berth
senses.example: Sailors give a wide berth to the reef's sharp edge.
senses.exampleCN: 水手们对礁石锋利的边缘敬而远之。
senses.why: The mooring room widens metaphorically to any safe margin.
senses.whyCN: 「泊位余地」在比喻中扩大为任何安全余量。

intro.en: Berth probably comes from bear, meaning the space in which a ship can lie.
intro.cn: berth 一般认为源自 bear，指船能安然容纳的空间（来源不确定）。

abstract.en: Picture stepping aside from a growling dog.

core_image: 邻居的篱笆一年往里挪一掌宽，等到发现时，那条小路已经窄得推不过独轮车
scene: 邻居的篱笆一年往里挪一掌宽，小路窄得推不过独轮车了。 The fence encroaches on the path a little more each year.
sceneCN: 这里 encroach 指「逐步侵占」（第 1 个义项：一点点越过界限占用他人的东西）；句意是篱笆每年往小路上多占一点。

senses.title: To take land gradually
senses.definition: to take over land or space little by little beyond a limit
senses.definitionCN: （动词）越过界限一点点占用土地或空间
senses.example: The fence encroaches on the path a little more each year.
senses.exampleCN: 篱笆每年往小路上多占一点。
senses.why: A fence moved inward a palm width each year until a barrow cannot pass
senses.whyCN: 篱笆每年往里挪一掌宽，直到独轮车推不过去

senses.title: To intrude on rights

senses.why: A lens angled through a window that was always left open
senses.whyCN: 一只镜头斜对着那扇一直开着的窗

intro.en: Encroach comes from Old French encrochier, to hook or seize, from croc, a hook; to encroach is to pull a thing toward you with a hook, a little at a time.
intro.cn: encroach 来自古法语 encrochier（钩住、抓取），源自 croc（钩子）；encroach 就是用钩子把东西一点点往自己这边拉。

items.en: Croc means a hook, and gives English crook and crochet.
items.cn: croc 意为钩子，给出英语 crook 与 crochet。

items.en: Encrochier means to hook or to seize, from en- plus croc.
items.cn: encrochier 意为钩住、抓取，由 en- 加 croc 构成。

items.en: English takes encroach for seizing property bit by bit.
items.cn: 英语借入 encroach，指一点点侵占财产。

items.en: Law uses encroach of intrusion on the rights of another.
items.cn: 法律用 encroach 指对他人权利的侵入。

items.en: The noun encroachment appears in property and boundary disputes.
items.cn: 名词 encroachment 出现在财产与边界纠纷中。

items.en: Modern use extends encroach to work eating into private hours.
items.cn: 现代用法把 encroach 扩展到工作侵占私人时间。

note.en: Encroach and encroachment come from Old French croc, a hook; intrude and trespass are near in meaning but do not carry the image of pulling little by little.
note.cn: encroach 与 encroachment 来自古法语 croc（钩子）；intrude 与 trespass 意思接近，却不带一点点往回拉的意象。

dict_mnemonic.text: encroach ＝ en-（使进入）＋ croch（钩子，古法语 croc）＝「用钩子一点点拉过来」→ 侵占、蚕食。名词 encroachment 侵占、侵害，同根 crook 钩状杖、骗子，crochet 钩针编织。三类用法：土地 encroach on land 侵占土地、encroach on territory 侵入领地；权利 encroach upon rights 侵害权利、encroach on privacy 侵犯隐私；时间 encroach on time 占用时间、encroach gradually 逐步蚕食。几乎总与 on 或 upon 连用，是不及物动词，不能说 encroach something。注意 encroach 强调渐进、每次一点点，trespass 强调一次越界，intrude 强调不请自来。

intro.cn: encroach 由 en- 加 croch- 组成；-ment 给出 encroachment，钩子这个词根也给出 crook 与 crochet。

latinIntro.en: Old French croc means a hook and encrochier to seize with a hook; the same hook gives crochet and crook.
latinIntro.cn: 古法语 croc 意为钩子，encrochier 意为用钩子抓取；同一个钩子给出 crochet 与 crook。

definition_zh: 通货紧缩；放气；泄气；削减；风蚀
definition_en: a sustained fall in the general level of prices, or the act of letting air out of something
core_image: 渔村的鱼价一月比一月低，摊主把价签往下改，欠的债却一分没少
scene: 海边的渔村在萧条里过了两年，鱼价一月比一月低，摊主把价签往下改，欠的债却一分没少。 Shops cut prices again and again, and the town slid into deflation.
sceneCN: 这里 deflation 指「一般物价水平持续下跌」（第 1 个义项：整体物价持续走低、货币购买力上升）；句意为店铺一再降价，小镇滑入通缩。图中可辨识物件：下调的价签、空鱼筐、账本、紧闭的店门。

pos.zh: 通货紧缩；放气；泄气；风蚀

senses.title: A sustained fall in the price level
senses.definition: a continuing decrease in the general level of prices, so that money gains purchasing power over time
senses.definitionCN: 整体物价水平持续下降，使同样多的钱随时间买到更多东西
senses.example: Shops cut prices again and again, and the town slid into deflation.
senses.exampleCN: 店铺一再降价，小镇滑入通缩。
senses.why: The word is the mirror of inflation: the same balloon image is reversed, so the currency is pictured as being let down rather than blown up.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 inflation 的镜像：同一个气球意象被反过来，通货被想象成放气而不是吹胀。

senses.title: The act of letting air out
senses.definition: the act of releasing air or gas from a tyre, balloon or other inflated object
senses.definitionCN: 把空气或气体从轮胎、气球或其他充气物中放出的动作
senses.example: Deflation of the damaged tyre took only a moment.
senses.exampleCN: 给受损轮胎放气只用了一会儿。
senses.why: This is the literal sense of the Latin verb: de- 'down, away' plus flare 'to blow' means to blow away or let the air out.
senses.whyCN: 这是拉丁动词的字面义：de-「向下、离开」加 flare「吹」，意为吹走或放掉气。

senses.title: A loss of confidence
senses.definition: a state of lowered spirits after a setback, as if the person had been emptied of air
senses.definitionCN: 受挫之后情绪低落的状态，仿佛人被抽空了气
senses.example: The defeat left a quiet deflation in the dressing room.
senses.exampleCN: 这场失利在更衣室里留下一种无声的泄气。
senses.why: The physical emptying of a balloon supplies a ready metaphor for morale, which the noun can carry without any economic content.
senses.whyCN: 把气球放空这一物理动作，为士气提供了现成的比喻，名词因此可以完全不带经济内容。

senses.title: A cut in scale or spending
senses.definition: a deliberate reduction in the size, cost or activity of something
senses.definitionCN: 有意缩减某事物的规模、成本或活动量
senses.example: The deflation of the program removed two of its four offices.
senses.exampleCN: 该项目缩减后，四个办事处关掉了两个。
senses.why: If blowing in expands a thing, letting air out contracts it, so the noun naturally serves any plan of shrinking.
senses.whyCN: 既然吹入使事物膨胀，放气就使它收缩，因此这个名词自然可用于任何缩减方案。

senses.title: Wind erosion of the land
senses.titleCN: 风把地表颗粒吹走的风蚀
senses.definition: the removal of loose soil or sand by wind, a geological process named after the blowing away of particles
senses.definitionCN: 风把松散土壤或沙粒吹走的地质过程，因颗粒被吹走而得名
senses.example: Deflation has stripped the dune field down to bare rock.
senses.exampleCN: 风蚀已把这片沙丘地剥到只剩裸岩。
senses.why: Geologists took the literal 'blow away' sense and applied it to wind lifting loose material off the surface.
senses.whyCN: 地质学家取了字面的「吹走」义，用来指风把松散物质从地表抬走。

senses.title: A policy of tightening
senses.definition: a government or central-bank policy that reduces demand, credit or public spending
senses.definitionCN: 政府或央行压低需求、信贷或公共开支的政策
senses.example: The deflation of credit came before the fall in output.
senses.exampleCN: 信贷的紧缩先于产出的下降。
senses.why: Policy language borrows the noun because the aim is to take air out of an overheated economy.
senses.whyCN: 政策话语借用这个名词，因为目的正是给过热的经济放掉一些气。

senses.title: Debt deflation
senses.titleCN: 物价下跌加重债务的债务紧缩
senses.definition: the process in which falling prices make existing debts heavier in real terms and force further cuts
senses.definitionCN: 物价下跌使既有债务按实值变重、并迫使进一步缩减的过程
senses.example: Debt deflation turned the slowdown into a long stagnation.
senses.exampleCN: 债务紧缩把放缓拖成了长期停滞。
senses.why: When the measure of value itself shrinks, every fixed debt grows relative to it, and the word names that self-feeding loop.
senses.whyCN: 当价值尺度本身缩小时，每一笔固定债务相对它就变重，这个词命名的正是这种自我喂养的循环。

senses.title: The deflation rate
senses.definition: a percentage expressing the pace at which the general price level is falling
senses.definitionCN: 表示整体物价水平下降速度的百分数
senses.example: The deflation rate eased to one percent in the spring.
senses.exampleCN: 通缩率在春季放缓至百分之一。
senses.why: As with inflation, the process noun comes to stand for its own measurement, so it can be attached directly to rate.
senses.whyCN: 与 inflation 一样，过程名词转指自身的度量，因此可以直接与 rate 搭配。

intro.en: Deflation is built on Latin deflare 'to blow away', from de- 'down, away' and flare 'to blow'; the economic sense was formed as the counterpart of inflation in the nineteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: deflation 建立在拉丁 deflare「吹走」之上，即 de-「向下、离开」加 flare「吹」；经济义是 19 世纪作为 inflation 的对立面而形成的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Flare meant 'to blow, to breathe out', the source of a small family of English words about blowing.
items.cn: flare 意为「吹、呼出气」，是英语中一小族「吹气」词的来源。

items.en: De- 'down, away' plus flare gave deflare 'to blow away, to blow off', used of wind and of emptying something by blowing.
items.cn: de-「向下、离开」加 flare 构成 deflare「吹走、吹掉」，用于风，也指吹气把某物腾空。

items.en: The English verb deflate appeared in the nineteenth century for letting air or gas out of a balloon, tyre or cavity.
items.cn: 英语动词 deflate 于 19 世纪出现，指把空气或气体从气球、轮胎或腔体中放出。

items.en: The economic noun is generally dated to the nineteenth century and was consciously coined as the opposite of inflation, reversing the same balloon image.
items.cn: 经济义名词一般认为是 19 世纪的产物，并被有意造作 inflation 的反面，把同一个气球意象反转过来。

items.en: Nineteenth-century geology applied the literal 'blowing away' sense to wind stripping loose sand and soil from the surface.
items.cn: 19 世纪的地质学把字面的「吹走」义用于风把松散沙土从地表剥走。

items.en: Because the word was built by analogy rather than inherited, its first economic use is generally placed in the nineteenth century, though the precise decade is not fixed here.
items.cn: 由于这个词是按类比而非继承造出的，其最早经济用例一般被认为在 19 世纪，确切年代此处不作定论。

note.en: The first group holds the mirror process, the verb behind it, and one look-alike with a different job; the second holds declines of prices, of inflation and of output.
note.cn: 第一组是镜像过程、其背后的动词，以及一个外形相近但作用不同的词；第二组是物价下降、通胀放慢与产出下降。

entries.definition: Prices rise and money loses purchasing power; deflation is the same mechanism running backwards.
entries.definitionCN: 物价上涨、货币购买力下降；deflation 是同一机制反向运行。

entries.definition: To let air out or to lower prices; the noun deflation names the process or its result.
entries.definitionCN: 放气或压低价格；名词 deflation 指过程或结果。

entries.definition: Describes pressure that pushes prices down; it names the force, not the decline.
entries.definitionCN: 描述把物价往下压的力量；它指力量而非下跌本身。

entries.definition: In statistics, a deflator is a price index used to strip inflation out of nominal figures; it is a tool, not a process.
entries.definitionCN: 在统计中，deflator 是用来从名义数字里剔除物价变动影响的指数；它是工具，不是过程。

entries.definition: An everyday phrase for falling prices; it may describe one good, whereas deflation means the general level.
entries.definitionCN: 日常说法，指价格下跌；可指单一商品，而 deflation 指整体水平。

entries.definition: A slowing of inflation while prices are still rising; unlike deflation, the level does not fall.
entries.definitionCN: 物价仍在上涨、只是涨幅放缓；与 deflation 不同，水平并未下降。

entries.definition: A deep and long slump in output and employment; deflation may accompany it but is a separate price phenomenon.
entries.definitionCN: 产出与就业的深重长期低迷；通缩可与之并存，但属于独立的价格现象。

entries.definition: A policy of cutting public spending; it is a chosen response, not a movement of prices.
entries.definitionCN: 削减公共开支的政策；它是主动选择的对策，不是价格运动。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: a real Latin prefix and root, a real family and real fixed phrases, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁前缀与词根、真实的同族词与真实的固定说法，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: de- 'down, away' plus flare 'to blow': to blow the air out.
normal.cn: de-「向下、离开」加 flare「吹」：把气吹走。

normal.en: The family runs deflate, deflation, deflationary, deflator, inflate, inflation.
normal.cn: 同族词串成一线：deflate、deflation、deflationary、deflator、inflate、inflation。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: price deflation, deflationary pressure, debt deflation, deflation spiral.
normal.cn: 固定说法：物价下跌、通缩压力、债务紧缩、通缩螺旋。

normal.en: Remember the pair by the prefix: in- blows up, de- lets out.
normal.cn: 用前缀记这一对：in- 往里吹，de- 往外放。

normal.en: Geology uses the literal sense: wind blowing loose sand away.
normal.cn: 地质学用字面义：风把松散沙粒吹走。

abstract.en: Picture a balloon slowly losing its shape against a wall.
abstract.cn: 想象一只气球贴着墙慢慢瘪下去。

abstract.en: Picture a price tag being crossed out and rewritten lower, twice in a month.
abstract.cn: 想象一张价签被划掉、改低，一个月里改了两次。

abstract.en: Picture a debt that grows heavier while the shop's takings shrink.
abstract.cn: 想象店里的进账越来越薄，欠的债却越来越重。

examples.en: Deflation punishes borrowers because their debts stay fixed while incomes fall.
examples.cn: 通缩惩罚借款人，因为收入下降而债务不变。

examples.en: The central bank denied that the economy was entering deflation.
examples.cn: 央行否认经济正进入通缩。

examples.en: Wind deflation has left a shallow basin in the plateau.
examples.cn: 风蚀在高原上留下一个浅盆地。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「de（向下）+ flat（气）+ ion」——把气往下放掉，越放越瘪 → 放气、通缩

root: 拉丁 deflare「吹走」= de-「向下、离开」+ flare「吹」→ 英语 deflate / deflation；经济义为 19 世纪按 inflation 反向类比造出，确切年代不作定论；地质义亦出自字面「吹走」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one reversed gesture: air is let out, the thing slackens, and the same slackening is applied to prices, to morale, to a budget, to the land, to credit and finally to a spiral of debt.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个反向动作展开：把气放掉，物体瘪下去；同一种「瘪下去」再依次用于物价、士气、预算、土地、信贷，最后是债务的螺旋。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a balloon going slack, a price tag rewritten lower, and a debt that does not shrink with it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只瘪下去的气球、一张改低的价签，以及一笔并不随之缩小的债。

branches.en: PRICE AND RATE: the falling level of prices is measured and reported as a percentage.
branches.cn: 物价与比率：下跌的物价水平被度量并报告为一个百分数。

branches.en: AIR AND SPIRIT: letting air out of a thing mirrors the emptying of confidence.
branches.cn: 气与心气：把物体放空，正映照着信心的被抽空。

branches.en: SCALE: the same release becomes a deliberate cut in size or spending.
branches.cn: 规模：同一种「放掉」变成对规模或开支的有意削减。

branches.en: LAND: wind literally blows the loose surface away.
branches.cn: 土地：风把松散的地表真的吹走。

branches.en: CREDIT AND DEBT: tightening policy meets the loop in which cheaper money makes fixed debt heavier.
branches.cn: 信贷与债务：紧缩政策遇上「钱变便宜反而使固定债务变重」的循环。

intro.en: The word is a Latin prefix, a Latin verb root and a noun suffix; the same three pieces build its mirror image and a whole small family.
intro.cn: 这个词由一个拉丁前缀、一个拉丁动词词根与一个名词后缀构成；这三段也构成它的镜像词与整个小词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin flare 'to blow' gives deflate, deflation, deflator, inflate, inflation and flatus; de- and in- mark the two opposite directions.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 flare「吹」衍生出 deflate、deflation、deflator、inflate、inflation 与 flatus；de- 与 in- 标出两个相反方向。

items.example: The prefix points the blowing outward.
The root supplies the image of moving air.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根提供推动空气的意象。

items.meaning: to blow away; to blow out
items.example: The compound names emptying by blowing.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合形式指用吹气腾空。

items.example: The Latin noun underlies the English form.
items.exampleCN: 这个拉丁名词是英语形式的基础。

items.example: The suffix turns the verb into a process noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成过程名词。

items.meaning: to let air out; to lower prices
items.example: The verb appeared in the nineteenth century.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词于 19 世纪出现。

items.example: The adjective names the pressure, not the fall.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词指压力，而非下跌。

items.meaning: a price index; a device for letting air out
items.example: The deflator strips price change from nominal output.
items.exampleCN: 平减指数从名义产出中剔除了价格变动。

definition_zh: 数据分析
definition_en: the process of inspecting, cleaning, transforming and modelling data in order to extract useful information and support conclusions
core_image: 桌上一叠原始表格，旁边屏幕显示清洗后的图表，废纸篓里装着删掉的错误行
scene: 桌上摊着一叠原始表格，旁边屏幕显示清洗后的图表，废纸篓里装着删掉的错误行。 Data analysis turns a messy table into a claim that can be checked.
sceneCN: 这里指对数据进行检查、清洗与建模的整个过程（第 1 个义项：系统的数据考察）；句意为数据分析把一张杂乱的表格变成可核查的主张。图中可辨识物件：原始表格、屏幕图表、废纸篓、键盘、批注笔。

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 datum 的复数而来，义为「数据」
由拉丁语 dare「给出」的过去分词而来，义为「给定的事实；数据点」
由希腊语 analusis「拆解」而来，义为「分析」
由其动词形式而来，义为「分析」
由该动词加表示施动者的词尾构成，义为「分析者」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「分析的」

senses.title: The general process of examining data
senses.definition: the whole sequence of inspecting, cleaning, transforming and interpreting data to answer a question
senses.definitionCN: 为回答问题而检查、清洗、转换与解释数据的完整流程
senses.example: Data analysis turns a messy table into a claim that can be checked.
senses.exampleCN: 数据分析把一张杂乱的表格变成可核查的主张。
senses.why: Raw records do not answer questions by themselves; they must be ordered before they can speak.
senses.whyCN: 原始记录本身不回答问题，必须先被整理才能说话。

senses.title: Statistical analysis
senses.definition: the use of summary measures, models and tests to describe data and judge hypotheses
senses.definitionCN: 用汇总指标、模型与检验来描述数据并判断假设
senses.example: The statistical part of data analysis estimated the effect and its interval.
senses.exampleCN: 数据分析中的统计部分估计了效应及其区间。
senses.why: When the question is about size and uncertainty, the analysis needs a probability model.
senses.whyCN: 当问题涉及大小与不确定性时，分析就需要一个概率模型。

senses.title: Analysis of qualitative material
senses.definition: the systematic reading and coding of interviews, documents or observations to identify themes and meanings
senses.definitionCN: 对访谈、文件或观察进行系统阅读与编码，以识别主题与意义
senses.example: Data analysis of the transcripts produced four themes and a revised coding frame.
senses.exampleCN: 对逐字稿的数据分析产生了四个主题与一版修订编码框架。
senses.why: Not all evidence arrives as numbers, and text needs its own disciplined route from raw record to finding.
senses.whyCN: 并非所有证据都以数字到来，文本需要自己那条从原始记录到发现的严谨路径。

senses.title: Cleaning and preparation
senses.definition: the work of detecting missing values, errors, duplicates and inconsistencies before modelling begins
senses.definitionCN: 在建模开始前发现缺失值、错误、重复与不一致的工作
senses.example: Most of the data analysis time went into cleaning the merged files.
senses.exampleCN: 大部分数据分析时间花在清洗合并后的文件上。
senses.why: Every model assumes the table is already coherent, and someone must make that assumption true.
senses.whyCN: 每个模型都假定表格已经自洽，而必须有人把这个假定变成事实。

senses.title: Exploratory analysis
senses.definition: an open-ended examination of patterns, distributions and anomalies before a formal hypothesis is fixed
senses.definitionCN: 在正式假设确定之前，对模式、分布与异常进行的开放式考察
senses.example: Exploratory data analysis revealed a cluster that the original design had not expected.
senses.exampleCN: 探索性数据分析揭示出原始设计没有预料到的一个群体。
senses.why: The analyst first looks around the data without a verdict in mind, so that surprise can still occur.
senses.whyCN: 分析者先不带结论地环视数据，这样惊讶才有可能发生。

senses.title: Confirmatory analysis
senses.definition: a planned test of a stated hypothesis using rules fixed before the data are examined
senses.definitionCN: 用查看数据之前固定的规则，对已陈述假设进行计划性检验
senses.example: Confirmatory data analysis requires the model to be specified in advance.
senses.exampleCN: 验证性数据分析要求模型预先写明。
senses.why: Once a hypothesis is fixed, the analysis becomes a fair test rather than a search for a story.
senses.whyCN: 假设一旦固定，分析就成为公平检验，而不是寻找故事。

senses.title: Computational analysis
senses.definition: the use of algorithms, databases and software to process data at a scale beyond hand calculation
senses.definitionCN: 用算法、数据库与软件处理超出人工计算规模的数据
senses.example: The data analysis pipeline ran overnight on the cluster.
senses.exampleCN: 这条数据分析流水线在集群上跑了一整夜。
senses.why: Scale changes the method: what is possible with a thousand rows is not the same as what is possible with a billion.
senses.whyCN: 规模改变方法：一千行的可能与十亿行的可能不是一回事。

senses.title: Interpretation and reporting
senses.definition: the step that turns results into statements about the world, with limits, assumptions and uncertainty made explicit
senses.definitionCN: 把结果转化为关于世界的陈述，并明确限度、假设与不确定性
senses.example: The final stage of data analysis is writing what the numbers do and do not support.
senses.exampleCN: 数据分析的最后一步，是写清这些数字支持什么、不支持什么。
senses.why: A table of results is not yet a finding; someone must state what it means and where it stops.
senses.whyCN: 一张结果表还不是发现，必须有人说明它意味着什么、到哪里为止。

intro.en: Data analysis joins data, the plural of Latin datum, something given, to analysis, from Greek analusis, a loosening or dissolving.
intro.cn: 这个术语把 data（拉丁语 datum「被给予之物」的复数）与 analysis（希腊语 analusis「拆解」）组合起来。

items.en: Dare meant to give, and the participle datum named a thing given or granted.
items.cn: dare 意为给予，分词 datum 指被给予或授予之物。

items.en: Datum named a given fact, and its plural data became the English mass noun for records.
items.cn: datum 指给定的事实，其复数 data 成为英语中指记录的物质名词。

items.en: English used data for facts and later for digital records; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 英语用 data 指事实，后来指数字记录；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: Analusis meant a loosening or resolving of a compound into its parts.
items.cn: analusis 意为把复合体拆解为各部分的松开过程。

items.en: Ana- meant up or throughout, and luein meant to loosen; together they describe taking something apart.
items.cn: ana- 意为向上或贯穿，luein 意为松开；合起来指把某物拆开。

items.en: Statistics and computing joined the two words for the whole workflow from records to conclusions; the phrase is twentieth-century.
items.cn: 统计学与计算把这两个词组合成从记录到结论的完整流程；这个短语属二十世纪。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like data analysis; the second group names neighbouring stages of working with evidence.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与 data analysis 相近；第二组是与「处理证据」意思相邻的阶段。

entries.definition: Records, measurements or facts in any form.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何形式的记录、测量或事实。

entries.definition: A single given fact or measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 指单个给定的事实或测量值。

entries.definition: The breaking of a whole into its parts for examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指把整体拆成部分加以考察。

entries.definition: To carry out such an examination.
entries.definitionCN: 指进行这样的考察。

entries.definition: A person who performs analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 指从事分析的人。

entries.definition: The science and practice of summarising and testing data.
entries.definitionCN: 指对数据进行汇总与检验的学问与实践。

entries.definition: Detecting and correcting errors before analysis.
entries.definitionCN: 指在分析前发现并纠正错误。

entries.definition: Searching large datasets for unsuspected patterns.
entries.definitionCN: 指在大数据集中搜寻未预料到的模式。

entries.definition: Assigning meaning to results.
entries.definitionCN: 指为结果赋予意义。

entries.definition: Labelling qualitative material into categories.
entries.definitionCN: 指把定性材料标注为各类别。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations work through the real parts, word family and common phrases behind this term.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想依托这个术语背后真实的构词部件、同族词与常见搭配。

normal.en: Data is the plural of a word for something given, and analysis is a loosening, so the phrase means loosening what was given.
normal.cn: 「数据」是「被给予之物」的复数，「分析」是「松开」，这个短语指把被给予的东西拆开。

normal.en: Cleaning comes before modelling, because a model cannot repair an inconsistent table.
normal.cn: 清洗在建模之前，因为模型无法修复一张自相矛盾的表格。

normal.en: Exploratory analysis looks around, while confirmatory analysis tests a promise made earlier.
normal.cn: 探索性分析四处环视，验证性分析检验早先作出的承诺。

normal.en: The last step is not a number but a sentence with limits attached.
normal.cn: 最后一步不是一个数字，而是一句带着限度的话。

normal.en: Computing changed the scale of data analysis without changing its need for a question.
normal.cn: 计算改变了数据分析的规模，却没有改变它对问题的需要。

abstract.en: Data do not speak; analysis is the grammar that makes them audible.
abstract.cn: 数据不会说话，分析是使它们可被听见的语法。

abstract.en: A clean table is already an argument about what counts as an error.
abstract.cn: 一张干净的表格本身已经是关于「什么算错误」的论证。

abstract.en: The model at the end inherits every decision made at the beginning.
abstract.cn: 最后的模型继承了开始时的每一个决定。

examples.en: The paper describes the data analysis in enough detail for replication.
examples.cn: 论文对数据分析的描述详细到可以复做。

examples.en: Data analysis was separated from data collection to reduce the risk of bias.
examples.cn: 数据分析与数据收集分开，以降低偏差风险。

examples.en: The data analysis showed a pattern that the original hypothesis had not predicted.
examples.cn: 数据分析显示出一个原假设没有预测到的模式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「数据」加「分析」——先把杂乱表格洗干净，再拆开看结构，最后写成一句可核查的话：数据分析。

root: 拉丁 dare「给予」→ 过去分词 datum「被给予之物」→ 复数 data；希腊 analusis「拆解」← ana-「贯穿」+ luein「松开」→ 英语 analysis；统计学与计算把两者组合为 data analysis。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move through the workflow: the general process, statistical analysis, qualitative analysis, cleaning, exploration, confirmation, computation, and interpretation.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着流程展开：总体过程、统计分析、定性分析、清洗、探索、验证、计算，以及解释。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a stack of raw tables on a desk, a screen with a cleaned chart beside them, and deleted error rows in the wastebasket.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上一叠原始表格，旁边屏幕显示清洗后的图表，废纸篓里装着删掉的错误行。

branches.en: THE WORKFLOW AND THE CLEANING: the whole sequence, and the unglamorous work that makes it possible.
branches.cn: 流程与清洗：完整顺序，以及使顺序成为可能的琐碎工作。

branches.en: THE TWO KINDS OF EVIDENCE: numbers handled statistically, and texts handled qualitatively.
branches.cn: 两类证据：用统计处理的数字，用定性处理的文本。

branches.en: THE TWO MODES OF INQUIRY: looking around before a hypothesis, and testing one fixed in advance.
branches.cn: 两种探究方式：假设前的环视，与预先固定假设后的检验。

branches.en: THE SCALE: algorithms and software processing more than hands can hold.
branches.cn: 规模：算法与软件处理超出人手所能掌握的数据。

branches.en: THE SENTENCE AT THE END: results converted into a claim with limits.
branches.cn: 结尾的句子：结果被转换成带限度的话。

intro.en: The phrase joins the plural of a Latin participle meaning given to a Greek noun meaning a loosening.
intro.cn: 这个短语把拉丁语「被给予」的分词复数与希腊语「拆解」名词组合起来。

latinIntro.en: Latin dare and datum supply data; Greek ana- and luein supply analysis; English plurals and compound syntax do the joining.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dare 与 datum 提供「数据」，希腊语 ana- 与 luein 提供「分析」，英语复数形式与复合句法完成连接。

items.example: It supplies the participle behind data.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 data 背后的分词。

items.example: The singular still names one measurement.
English treats it as a mass noun.
items.exampleCN: 英语把它当作物质名词。

items.example: It marks taking a whole apart.
It supplies the dissolving image in analysis.
items.exampleCN: 它提供 analysis 中「拆解」的意象。

items.structure: Greek noun from ana- plus luein

items.meaning: the separation of a whole into parts
items.example: The second half names the operation.
It forms analyse; American spelling uses -ize.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 analyse；美式拼写作 -ize。

items.meaning: the workflow from records to claims
items.example: The compound is modern and covers many methods.
items.exampleCN: 这个复合词是现代用语，涵盖多种方法。

latinEntries.structure: analysis, analysis (f., third declension, from Greek analusis)

derivatives.zh: 由拉丁语 datum 的复数而来，义为「数据」
由拉丁语 dare「给出」的过去分词而来，义为「给定的事实；数据点」

由该动词加表示施动者的词尾构成，义为「分析者」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「分析的」

definition_zh: n. 厄运；劫数；毁灭；末日审判；（古）判决 v. 注定（失败或死亡）；判定
definition_en: death or a terrible fate that cannot be avoided, or to make such a fate certain
core_image: 灰天空下一道干涸的河床与一排空屋；一道细缝在混凝土墙上越裂越宽；一本日历上剩下的每个日期都被划掉；一杆画出来的天平在深坑上方称量灵魂
scene: 坝上那道细缝越裂越宽，山谷里的人开始搬东西。 The crack in the dam spelled doom for the valley.
sceneCN: 这里 doom 是「毁灭」（第 2 个义项：死亡、毁灭或希望的终结）；句意：坝上的裂缝意味着山谷的毁灭。图中可辨识物件：混凝土坝、越裂越宽的缝、搬东西的人、山谷房屋。

pos.zh: 厄运；劫数；毁灭；末日审判

senses.title: An unavoidable fate
senses.definition: a terrible fate that cannot be escaped
senses.definitionCN: （名词）无法逃脱的可怕命运
senses.example: The village accepted its doom without a sound.
senses.exampleCN: 村子一声不响地接受了它的厄运。
senses.why: A dry riverbed and a line of empty houses under a grey sky.
senses.whyCN: 灰天空下一道干涸的河床与一排空屋。

senses.title: Death or ruin
senses.definition: death, destruction or the end of hope
senses.definitionCN: （名词）死亡、毁灭或希望的终结
senses.example: The crack in the dam spelled doom for the valley.
senses.exampleCN: 坝上的裂缝意味着山谷的毁灭。
senses.why: A thin crack widening across a concrete wall.
senses.whyCN: 一道细缝在混凝土墙上越裂越宽。

senses.title: Make a fate certain
senses.definition: to make a bad outcome certain for someone or something
senses.definitionCN: （动词）使某人或某物的坏结果成为定局
senses.example: The injury doomed the season for the team.
senses.exampleCN: 那次伤病注定了球队的赛季。
senses.why: A calendar with every remaining date crossed out.
senses.whyCN: 一本日历，剩下的每个日期都被划掉。

senses.title: The last judgement
senses.definition: the final judgement of souls in religious belief
senses.definitionCN: （名词）宗教信仰中对灵魂的最终审判
senses.example: The fresco shows the doom of the wicked.
senses.exampleCN: 那幅湿壁画描绘了恶人的末日审判。
senses.why: A painted scale weighing souls above a dark pit.
senses.whyCN: 一杆画出来的天平在深坑上方称量灵魂。

senses.title: An old legal sentence
senses.definition: a judicial sentence or decree, in older use
senses.definitionCN: （名词）旧用法中的司法判决或法令
senses.example: The chronicle records the doom pronounced by the king.
senses.exampleCN: 编年史记载了国王宣布的判决。
senses.why: A sealed scroll read aloud from a stone step.
senses.whyCN: 一卷封了印的文书在石阶上被宣读。

intro.en: Doom began as Old English dom, a judgement or decree, from the verb deman, to judge, which survives today as deem; once a sentence is read out the fate is fixed, so the word slid from judgement to ruin.
intro.cn: doom 起初是古英语 dom「判决、法令」，源自动词 deman「判定」，这个动词今天以 deem 的形式留存；判决一经宣读命运就定了，于是词义从「判决」滑向「毁灭」。

items.en: Old English dom means judgement or decree.
items.cn: 古英语 dom 意为判决、法令。

items.en: The related verb deman means to judge.
items.cn: 相关动词 deman 意为判定。

items.en: Middle English doom keeps the sense of a sentence passed.
items.cn: 中古英语 doom 保留「宣判」的意思。

items.en: The word shifts from the sentence to the fate it fixes.
items.cn: 词义从「判决」转向判决所定的命运。

items.en: The verb means to condemn to a fate.
items.cn: 动词意为判定某人落入某种命运。

items.en: Doom now names ruin, and doomsday the end of the world.
items.cn: doom 现在指毁灭，doomsday 指世界末日。

note.en: Doom is a fate fixed by a sentence; its look-alikes share the old judge stem, and its neighbours name other kinds of destined end.
note.cn: doom 是被判决定下的命运；形近词共用古老的「判定」词干，近义词则是别的注定的结局。

core_image: 一张盖着印章的纸从高处递下来，下面的人只能照办

senses.title: An official order

senses.example: The king signed a royal decree.

senses.why: A stamp on paper that everyone must obey.

senses.title: A court decision

senses.why: A bench turning a dispute into a rule.

senses.why: A knot cut by a written line.

senses.title: Order by authority

senses.why: One voice making a rule for many.
senses.whyCN: 一个声音为许多人定下规则。

intro.en: Decree comes from Latin decretum, a decision, from decernere, to decide.
intro.cn: decree 源自拉丁语 decretum（决定），来自 decernere（判定）。

items.en: Cernere meant to separate or sift.
items.cn: cernere 意为分开或筛。

items.en: Decernere meant to decide by separating options.
items.cn: decernere 意为通过区分选项来判定。

items.en: Decretum named what had been decided.
items.cn: decretum 指已经判定的事。

items.en: Decret carried the sense into French.
items.cn: decret 把这个含义带入法语。

items.en: Decree entered English for an official order.
items.cn: 十四世纪 decree 以正式命令义进入英语。

items.en: Decree was standard in divorce and church law.
items.cn: 十九世纪 decree 是离婚法与教会法的常用词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the dec- opening; the near-meaning group names official orders.
