definition_zh: 问题解决；找出办法排除障碍、达到目标的过程或能力
definition_en: the process or skill of finding a way around an obstacle to reach a goal
core_image: 一团缠住的线被一根根理开，直到通路出现
scene: 水管突然漏水，父亲先关阀门，再逐段检查接头，最后换上新的密封圈。 The father shuts the valve, checks each joint in turn and finally fits a new seal, a calm exercise in problem-solving.
sceneCN: 这里 problem-solving 指「找出办法排除障碍的过程」（第 1 个义项：从障碍到可行方案的一串步骤）；句意为父亲先关阀、再逐段排查、最后换密封圈，冷静地把漏水问题解决掉。图中可辨识物件：水管、阀门、接头、新密封圈。

pos.zh: 问题解决的；用于解决问题的（作定语）

senses.title: The process of removing an obstacle
senses.definition: the sequence of steps by which an obstacle is identified and removed
senses.definitionCN: 识别并排除障碍的一连串步骤
senses.example: The father shuts the valve, checks the joints and fits a new seal.
senses.exampleCN: 父亲关掉阀门，检查接头，再换上新的密封圈。
senses.why: a problem is literally something thrown in the way, so problem-solving is the work of clearing what blocks the path.
senses.whyCN: problem 字面上是「扔到路上的东西」，因此 problem-solving 就是清走挡路之物的工夫。

senses.title: Problem-solving ability
senses.definition: the capacity to find effective solutions, measured in tests and jobs
senses.definitionCN: 找到有效解决办法的能力，在测验与工作中被衡量
senses.example: The interview tests problem-solving more than memory.
senses.exampleCN: 这场面试考的是解决问题的能力，而非记忆。
senses.why: the same compound can name a skill because a process repeated well becomes a capacity.
senses.whyCN: 同一复合词也能命名一种技能，因为做得好的过程会变成能力。

senses.title: Solving a mathematics problem
senses.definition: working from given conditions to a required answer by valid steps
senses.definitionCN: 从已知条件出发，用有效步骤得到所求答案
senses.example: The class spent an hour on problem-solving with fractions.
senses.exampleCN: 全班花了一小时做分数解题。
senses.why: mathematics gives the word its clearest form: a stated obstacle, allowed moves, and a checkable end.
senses.whyCN: 数学给了这个词最清晰的形式：明确的障碍、允许的步骤、可检验的终点。

senses.title: Algorithmic solving in computing
senses.definition: designing or applying an algorithm that transforms an input into a required output
senses.definitionCN: 设计或应用把输入变成所需输出的算法
senses.example: The team improved problem-solving by splitting the task into subproblems.
senses.exampleCN: 团队把任务拆成子问题，从而改进了求解。
senses.why: a computer cannot improvise, so the process must be written as repeatable rules; that makes the phrase technical.
senses.whyCN: 计算机不能临场发挥，过程必须写成可重复的规则；这使该短语成为技术用语。

senses.title: Troubleshooting equipment
senses.definition: locating a fault in a machine or system and restoring it to work
senses.definitionCN: 找出机器或系统中的故障并使其恢复运作
senses.example: The technician's problem-solving began with the power supply.
senses.exampleCN: 技术员的问题解决从电源开始。
senses.why: engineering adds a physical object: the obstacle is a failed part, and the solution is a working machine.
senses.whyCN: 工程加上一个物理对象：障碍是坏掉的部件，方案是运转的机器。

senses.title: A research topic in cognitive psychology
senses.titleCN: 认知心理学的研究课题
senses.definition: the study of how people represent a goal, search a space of moves and choose a solution
senses.definitionCN: 研究人如何表征目标、搜索可能的步骤并选择方案
senses.example: Problem-solving is studied through puzzles and planning tasks.
senses.exampleCN: 问题解决通过谜题与计划任务来研究。
senses.why: psychologists ask what happens between reading a task and answering it, and the compound names that hidden interval.
senses.whyCN: 心理学家追问从读到题目到给出答案之间发生了什么，这个复合词命名那段看不见的间隔。

senses.title: Team and organizational solving
senses.titleCN: 团队与组织层面的问题解决
senses.definition: a group process for diagnosing a shared problem and agreeing on action
senses.definitionCN: 群体诊断共同问题并就行动达成一致的过程
senses.example: The staff used a weekly meeting for problem-solving across departments.
senses.exampleCN: 员工每周开会做跨部门的问题解决。
senses.why: when a problem belongs to no single person, the steps must be shared, and the phrase moves from a mind to a room.
senses.whyCN: 当问题不属于任何单个人时，步骤必须共享，这个短语便从一个脑袋移到一间屋子。

senses.title: Resolving conflict
senses.titleCN: 冲突调解与实际矛盾的处理
senses.definition: finding an arrangement that meets the interests of parties in dispute
senses.definitionCN: 找到兼顾争议各方利益的安排
senses.example: The mediator's problem-solving kept the two sides talking.
senses.exampleCN: 调解者的问题解决让双方继续谈下去。
senses.why: a conflict is an obstacle made of people, so the same steps apply: define the block, list options, test a solution.
senses.whyCN: 冲突是由人构成的障碍，因此同样适用：界定阻塞、列出选项、检验方案。

intro.en: Problem-solving joins Greek problēma 'a thing put forward' with Latin solvere 'to loosen'. The compound is modern English, though both halves are old. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: problem-solving 把希腊 problēma「被抛到前面之物」与拉丁 solvere「松开」连在一起。复合词是现代英语构造，两半都很古老。年代为约数。

items.en: Problem goes back to Greek proballein 'to throw forward', from pro- 'before' plus ballein 'to throw'; a problēma was a task or riddle put in front of someone.
items.cn: problem 可追溯到希腊 proballein「向前抛出」，由 pro-「在前」加 ballein「投掷」构成；problēma 就是摆在人面前的题目或谜语。

items.en: The noun problēma meant 'a thing put forward, a task, a question for debate'; Latin borrowed it as problema.
items.cn: 名词 problēma 意为「被提出之物、任务、待辩的问题」；拉丁语借作 problema。

items.en: Solvere meant 'to loosen, untie, dissolve, pay'; the metaphor of untying a knot is what solving a problem still carries.
items.cn: solvere 意为「松开、解开、溶解、偿付」；「解开一个结」的比喻至今仍留在「解决问题」这一说法中。

items.en: Problem entered English in the sixteenth century through French; problem-solving as a fixed compound is recorded only in modern usage, especially after psychology and computing adopted it.
items.cn: problem 经法语在 16 世纪进入英语；problem-solving 作为固定复合词只见于现代用法，尤其在心理学与计算领域采用之后。

items.en: Source uncertain (first dates): the first use of the hyphenated compound is not precisely recorded, and Greek ballein has no reliable Latin cognate, so the Latin list covers only the solving half.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：带连字符的复合词最早用法没有精确记录；希腊 ballein 没有可靠的拉丁同族词，因此拉丁词条只覆盖「解决」这一半。

note.en: Group one holds forms and spellings that are easily confused; group two holds related activities that are not identical with solving a problem.
note.cn: 第一组是易混的形式与拼写；第二组是相关但并不等同于「解决问题」的活动。

entries.definition: The same compound written as two words; the unhyphenated form is common when it is used as a noun.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个复合词写成两个词；作名词时无连字符形式很常见。

entries.definition: A person who solves problems; the agent noun adds -er, while problem-solving names the activity.
entries.definitionCN: 解决问题的人；施动名词加 -er，而 problem-solving 命名活动。

entries.definition: The difficulty itself, before any solution; solving is the response to it.
entries.definitionCN: 困难本身，尚未有方案；solving 是对它的回应。

entries.definition: The answer or arrangement that removes the difficulty; problem-solving is the road, solution the destination.
entries.definitionCN: 消除困难的答案或安排；problem-solving 是路，solution 是终点。

entries.definition: Locating and fixing faults in equipment; it is the engineering branch of problem-solving.
entries.definitionCN: 找出并修复设备故障；是问题解决在工程中的分支。

entries.definition: Selecting among options; solving a problem usually includes a decision, but the two are not the same act.
entries.definitionCN: 在选项中选择；解决问题通常包含决策，但两者不是同一动作。

entries.definition: Moving from premises to conclusions; it is one tool used inside problem-solving.
entries.definitionCN: 从前提走向结论；是问题解决中使用的一种工具。

entries.definition: Settling a dispute between parties; it applies problem-solving to social conflict.
entries.definitionCN: 解决各方争议；把问题解决用于社会冲突。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: pro- 'before' + ballein 'throw' gives a thing thrown in your path; solvere 'untie' gives the act of clearing it.
normal.cn: pro-「在前」+ ballein「投掷」= 扔到你路上的东西；solvere「解开」= 清走它的动作。

normal.en: The family runs problem, solve, solution, solvable and problem-solver.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 problem、solve、solution、solvable 与 problem-solver。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: problem-solving skills, the problem-solving process, collaborative problem-solving.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：问题解决技能、问题解决过程、协作式问题解决。

normal.en: Mathematics and computing give the phrase its strictest form: stated input, allowed steps, checkable output.
normal.cn: 数学与计算给出这个短语最严格的形式：明确输入、允许步骤、可检验输出。

normal.en: A problem is the obstacle; a solution is the cleared path.
normal.cn: problem 是障碍，solution 是清出来的路。

abstract.en: Picture a knot in a rope, then a finger working one loop loose at a time.
abstract.cn: 想象绳上有个结，一根手指一圈圈把它挑松。

abstract.en: Picture a blocked pipe and a hand tracing the blockage joint by joint.
abstract.cn: 想象堵塞的管道，一只手一段段地摸到堵点。

abstract.en: Picture a maze where every wrong turn is marked before the right one is found.
abstract.cn: 想象一座迷宫，每个错弯都被标出之后才找到对的那条。

examples.en: The course teaches problem-solving through real case studies.
examples.cn: 这门课通过真实案例教授问题解决。

examples.en: Good problem-solving begins with a clear statement of the goal.
examples.cn: 好的问题解决始于对目标的清晰陈述。

examples.en: The team's collaborative problem-solving shortened the repair by days.
examples.cn: 团队的协作式问题解决把维修缩短了好几天。

dict_mnemonic.text: problem（难题）+ solving（解决）——把挡路的难题解开 → 问题解决

root: problem 源自希腊 problēma「被抛出之物」← proballein（pro- 在前 + ballein 投掷）；solving 源自拉丁 solvere「解开」。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the clearing of a path: the steps, the skill, the mathematics, the algorithm, the broken machine, the hidden mental search, the shared room, and the conflict between people.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿「清出一条路」展开：步骤、技能、数学、算法、坏掉的机器、看不见的心智搜索、共享的会议室，以及人与人之间的冲突。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a knot loosened loop by loop until the rope runs free.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个结被一圈圈挑松，直到绳子重新通畅。

branches.en: THE LOOP: goal, barrier, analysis, plan, trial and resolution is the minimal complete shape.
branches.cn: 循环：目标、障碍、分析、计划、尝试与解决构成最小的完整形状。

branches.en: CAPACITY: a loop repeated well becomes a skill that tests can measure.
branches.cn: 能力：循环做得好，就成为测验可测量的技能。

branches.en: FORMAL MODELS: mathematics and algorithms make the steps explicit and checkable.
branches.cn: 形式模型：数学与算法让步骤明确且可检验。

branches.en: THE BROKEN OBJECT: engineering turns the obstacle into a faulty part.
branches.cn: 坏掉的物件：工程把障碍变成一个坏部件。

branches.en: MIND, ROOM, RELATION: the same loop runs silently in a head, openly in a team, and between opposing sides.
branches.cn: 心智、房间、关系：同一条循环在脑中无声进行，在团队中公开进行，也在对立双方之间进行。

intro.en: Problem-solving is a compound of two borrowings: a Greek noun of obstruction and a Latin verb of loosening, joined by the English -ing form.
intro.cn: problem-solving 是两个借词的复合：一个希腊的「阻塞」名词与一个拉丁的「松开」动词，由英语 -ing 形式连接。

latinIntro.en: Latin solvere 'to loosen' supplies solve, solution, solvable and solvent; Greek problēma supplies problem. The two halves come from different languages and must not be forced into one root.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 solvere「松开」提供 solve、solution、solvable 与 solvent；希腊 problēma 提供 problem。两半来自不同语言，不能强行并成一个词根。

items.example: Pro- places the task in front of the solver.
items.exampleCN: pro- 把任务摆在解题者面前。
ballein 也出现在 ballistic 中。

items.meaning: a thing put forward, a task
items.exampleCN: problēma 以 problema 进入拉丁语。

items.example: Solvere is the source of solve and solution.
items.exampleCN: solvere 是 solve 与 solution 的来源。

items.example: The suffix turns the verb solve into the activity of solving.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词 solve 变成「解决」这项活动。

items.meaning: a difficulty to be dealt with
items.example: The problem was a cracked joint.
items.exampleCN: 问题是一个裂开的接头。

items.example: She solved the puzzle in a minute.
items.exampleCN: 她一分钟就解开了谜题。

items.meaning: the act or result of loosening
items.example: The solution was a new seal.
items.exampleCN: 解决办法是换一个新密封圈。

items.example: Not every dispute is solvable at once.
items.exampleCN: 并非每场争议都能立刻解决。

items.meaning: a person skilled at finding solutions
items.example: A good problem-solver asks what the real goal is.
items.exampleCN: 善于解决问题的人会先问真正的目标是什么。

definition_zh: n. 才干，水准；（枪炮的）口径；（管子的）内径
definition_en: the quality of a person or work; the internal width of a gun barrel or tube
core_image: 枪管里那道被量得极准的圆
scene: 枪管的口径决定了能装进多大的弹。 The calibre of the barrel decides which bullets fit.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：calibre 指口径；句意是枪管的口径决定了能装进什么样的子弹。

senses.title: Quality of mind or work
senses.definition: the level of ability or quality that a person or thing shows
senses.definitionCN: 人或事物表现出的能力或品质水平
senses.example: We need someone of her calibre for the post.
senses.exampleCN: 这个职位需要她这种水准的人。
senses.why: The measured bore became a metaphor for measured ability.
senses.whyCN: 量准的口径被用作衡量能力的比喻。

senses.title: The width of a barrel
senses.definition: the inside diameter of a gun barrel or a tube
senses.definitionCN: 枪管或管子的内径
senses.example: The rifle fires a small calibre round.
senses.exampleCN: 这支步枪发射小口径子弹。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, from the mould used to cast shot.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，源自铸弹用的模子。

intro.en: Calibre comes from an Arabic word for a mould, which fixed the size of what was cast.
intro.cn: calibre 来自阿拉伯语「模子」，模子决定铸件的大小。

items.en: Qalib means a mould.
items.cn: qalib 意为模子。

items.en: Calibre means the bore of a gun.
items.cn: calibre 意为炮膛内径。

items.en: English adopts it for gun barrels.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语用来指枪管口径。

items.en: Writers speak of a man of calibre.
items.cn: 十八世纪出现「有分量的人」的说法。

items.en: Tubes and wires are graded by calibre.
items.cn: 十九世纪管材线材按口径分级。

items.en: Calibre means both bore and ability.
items.cn: 现代兼指口径与才干。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cal- opening; the near-meaning group puts quality words first and measuring words second.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cal- 开头；近义组先把「品质」类词放在前，再列测量类词。

entries.definition: To adjust against a standard.
entries.definitionCN: 校准。

entries.definition: The same word spelled without u.
entries.definitionCN: calibre 的美式拼法。

entries.definition: A tool for measuring diameter.
entries.definitionCN: 卡尺。

entries.definition: How good something is.
entries.definitionCN: 质量。

entries.definition: The value a person has earned.
entries.definitionCN: 价值；优点。

entries.definition: A standard measure of width.
entries.definitionCN: 规；口径。

entries.definition: The width across a round shape.
entries.definitionCN: 直径。

normalIntro.en: Calibre is the size of the hole and the size of the person.
normalIntro.cn: calibre 既是那个洞的尺寸，也是那个人的分量。

normal.en: A mould sets the size of a shot.
normal.cn: 模子决定弹丸大小。

normal.en: The barrel must match it.
normal.cn: 枪管必须与之相配。

normal.en: That width is the calibre.
normal.cn: 这个宽度就是口径。

normal.en: People also have a calibre.
normal.cn: 人也有「口径」般的分量。

normal.en: Same word, measured worth.
normal.cn: 同一个词，衡量价值。

abstract.en: A circle measured to the millimetre.
abstract.cn: 精确到毫米的一个圆。

abstract.en: The width that decides what fits.
abstract.cn: 决定什么能放进去的宽度。

abstract.en: Ability spoken of as a bore.
abstract.cn: 被当作膛径来谈论的能力。

examples.en: The journal publishes work of the highest calibre.
examples.cn: 这家期刊发表最高水准的研究。

examples.en: The pistol is of a smaller calibre than the rifle.
examples.cn: 这把枪的口径比步枪小。

examples.en: She is a lawyer of real calibre.
examples.cn: 她是一位真正有分量的律师。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「开利伯」——先量准口径，才谈得上水平。

root: 阿拉伯 qalib（模子）→ 法语 calibre（口径）→ 才干、水准

sensesIntro.en: The bore and the person are both measured: one by a gauge, the other by the work produced.
sensesIntro.cn: 膛径与人都在被衡量：一个用量规，一个看作品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a precisely measured circle inside a barrel
core.cn: 核心意象：枪管内部被量得极准的一个圆

branches.en: A lawyer of real weight.
branches.cn: 真正有分量的律师。

branches.en: Work that lifts a journal.
branches.cn: 撑起一本期刊的水准之作。

branches.en: A small round for a rifle.
branches.cn: 步枪用的小口径弹。

branches.en: A tube sized to the millimetre.
branches.cn: 精确到毫米的管径。

branches.en: One word for two kinds of measure.
branches.cn: 一个词，两种衡量。

intro.cn: calibre 是 calibrate 的来源名词；下面列出其词尾以及「测量」词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Arabic qalib is a mould, Greek diameter is a measure across, and Latin qualis means of what kind.
latinIntro.cn: 阿拉伯语 qalib 意为模子，希腊语 diameter 意为横量，拉丁语 qualis 意为「何种的」。

latinEntries.exampleCN: qalib 产生 calibre 与 calibrate。
diameter 产生 diameter 与 diametric。
qualis 产生 quality 与 qualify。

definition_zh: 投资组合；作品集；公文包；部长职位
definition_en: a collection of investments or works, or a case for carrying papers
core_image: 一只打开的文件夹，里面夹着分属不同领域的纸张
scene: 投资顾问把客户的资金分散到股票、债券与房产基金，随后摊开文件展示整份组合的年度表现。 Her portfolio holds a mix of bonds, shares and property funds.
sceneCN: 这里指「投资组合」，对应第 1 个义项：一个人或机构持有的全部投资；句意为她的组合包含债券、股票与房产基金。画面要点：摊开的文件夹、饼状配置图、年度报表。

pos.zh: 投资组合；作品集；公文包；部长职位；（职责）范围

derivatives.zh: （基金）持股公司；投资组合内公司

senses.title: A collection of investments
senses.definition: the full set of investments held by a person or institution
senses.definitionCN: 个人或机构持有的全部投资
senses.example: The fund rebalanced its portfolio in June.
senses.exampleCN: 该基金在六月调整了投资组合。
senses.why: The word for a case of papers becomes a word for a collection of financial claims: the case holds many sheets, and the investor holds many positions.
senses.whyCN: 原本指装纸的文件夹，转而指一叠金融主张的集合：文件包装许多纸，投资者握有许多头寸。

senses.title: A collection of works
senses.definition: a selection of an artist's or designer's work used to show their ability
senses.definitionCN: 艺术家或设计师用来展示能力的作品选辑
senses.example: She sent her portfolio to three design schools.
senses.exampleCN: 她把作品集寄给了三所设计学校。
senses.why: This keeps the literal case: a folder of samples carried to a meeting, where the collection itself is the argument.
senses.whyCN: 这里保留了字面的文件夹：一叠样张被带到会面现场，合集本身就是论据。

senses.title: A case for carrying papers
senses.definition: a flat case used to carry loose papers, drawings or documents
senses.definitionCN: 用来装散页、图纸或文件的扁平提包
senses.example: He left the meeting with a heavy portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 他带着一只沉重的公文包离开会场。
senses.why: This is the original object: a portable leaf-holder, from which every metaphorical collection sense grows.
senses.whyCN: 这是原本的物件：一只可携带的「装纸器」，所有比喻性的合集义都由它生长出来。

senses.title: A minister's office
senses.definition: the position and duties of a government minister
senses.definitionCN: 政府部长的职位与职务
senses.example: She was given the education portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 她获得了教育部长一职。
senses.why: A minister carries a bundle of responsibilities as if in a case, so the container comes to mean the office held.
senses.whyCN: 部长像提着一只箱子那样承担一束职责，于是容器转而指所担任的职位。

senses.title: A range of responsibilities
senses.definition: the set of duties assigned to one person or team
senses.definitionCN: 分配给一个人或团队的一整套职责
senses.example: Customer service is now part of his portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 客户服务现在属于他的职责范围。
senses.why: The office sense is generalized: any bundle of tasks can be a portfolio because it is a collection held by one owner.
senses.whyCN: 职位义被一般化：任何一束任务都能叫 portfolio，因为它是由一个主体持有的一组合集。

senses.title: An educational portfolio
senses.definition: a curated collection of a student's work used for assessment
senses.definitionCN: 为评估而整理的学生作品合集
senses.example: The course is graded through a portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课通过作品档案来评分。
senses.why: Assessment shifts from a single test to a carried collection, so the folder becomes evidence of learning over time.
senses.whyCN: 评估从单次考试转为一叠随身作品，文件夹于是成了长期学习的证据。

senses.title: A company's product range
senses.definition: the set of products or brands a company offers
senses.definitionCN: 一家公司提供的产品与品牌总体
senses.example: The firm sold its older brands to simplify its portfolio.
senses.exampleCN: 该公司出售较老的品牌以精简产品组合。
senses.why: Business treats its offerings as holdings to be balanced, so the investment-collection sense is applied to goods.
senses.whyCN: 企业把所售之物当作需要平衡的持有项，投资合集的义项于是被用到商品上。

senses.title: A collection of projects
senses.definition: a managed set of projects or assets considered together
senses.definitionCN: 被放在一起管理的一批项目或资产
senses.example: The office manages a portfolio of rural road projects.
senses.exampleCN: 该办公室管理着一批乡村道路项目。
senses.why: Any set of undertakings can be balanced like investments, so the word extends from money to work in progress.
senses.whyCN: 任何一束事业都能像投资那样被平衡，于是这个词从资金扩展到进行中的工作。

intro.en: Portfolio is an Italian compound meaning a case for carrying sheets, built from a verb for carrying and a word for a leaf. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: portfolio 是意大利语复合词，意为装纸张的提包，由一个表示「携带」的动词与一个表示「纸页」的词构成。年代均为约数。

items.en: Portare meant to carry, and it supplies the first half of the compound and words such as portable and transport.
items.cn: portare 意为携带，提供复合词的前半，也是 portable、transport 等词的来源。

items.en: Folium meant a leaf and also a sheet of paper, which is why a folio is a page and foliage is leafage.
items.cn: folium 意为树叶，也指纸页，所以 folio 指对开页，foliage 指枝叶。

items.en: The Italian compound joined the verb and the noun to name a case in which loose sheets were carried.
items.cn: 意大利语把这个动词与名词合起来，指用来携带散页的提包。

items.en: English borrowed the word through French forms and used it for a minister's case of state papers, then for the office itself.
items.cn: 英语经法语形式借入这个词，先指部长装公文的提包，再指职位本身。

items.en: Investors began to speak of the set of holdings they carried as a portfolio, turning the container into the collection.
items.cn: 投资者开始把所持有的一整套资产称为 portfolio，容器于是变成了合集本身。

note.en: The first group contains words built on the same carrying or leaf parts; the second group names other kinds of collection.
note.cn: 第一组是建立在同一个「携带」或「纸页」成分上的词；第二组是其他类型的合集。

entries.definition: A leaf of paper or a book made of large sheets; it is the sheet itself, not the case that carries it.
entries.definitionCN: 一张纸页或由大张纸装成的书；它是纸页本身，不是装它的提包。

entries.definition: Able to be carried easily; it shares the first element but says nothing about a collection.
entries.definitionCN: 便于携带的；共享第一个成分，但与合集无关。

entries.definition: A harbour or a wine, from Latin portus and portare respectively; only the wine sense shares the carrying verb.
entries.definitionCN: 港口或葡萄酒，分别出自拉丁语的不同词；只有葡萄酒义共享「携带」动词。

entries.definition: A travelling case, and later a word made by blending two words; it is a case, but not the paper-holder.
entries.definitionCN: 旅行箱，后指由两个词混合成的新词；它是箱子，但不是装纸的夹子。

entries.definition: Any set of things gathered together; portfolio is a specialized collection that is managed or assessed.
entries.definitionCN: 任何聚集起来的一批东西；portfolio 是被管理或被评估的专门合集。

entries.definition: The assets a person or fund owns; holdings is more concrete, while portfolio stresses the set as a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 个人或基金拥有的资产；holdings 更具体，portfolio 强调整套。

entries.definition: A flat case for carrying documents; it is the everyday object, while portfolio is the older Italian loan for the same item.
entries.definitionCN: 装文件的扁平提包；它是日常物件，portfolio 是同一物件的较早意大利语借词。

entries.definition: A file of papers about one person or case; it is a collection of documents, not of investments or works.
entries.definitionCN: 关于某人或某案的一叠文件；它是文件合集，不是投资或作品合集。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Italian parts meaning carry and leaf, real compounds and real fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的意大利语成分「携带」与「纸页」、真实复合词与真实固定搭配。

normal.en: Portare means carry and folium means leaf or sheet, so a portfolio is a sheet-carrier.
normal.cn: 前一半意为携带，后一半意为纸页，所以 portfolio 就是装纸页的器物。

normal.en: The case came first, the collection came later: investors now carry positions instead of papers.
normal.cn: 先有器物，后有合集：投资者如今携带的是头寸而不是纸页。

normal.en: A minister's portfolio is a bundle of duties carried as if in a case.
normal.cn: 部长的 portfolio 是一束像装在箱子里那样随身承担的职责。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the finance sense: investment portfolio, portfolio manager, loan portfolio.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出金融义：投资组合、组合经理、贷款组合。

normal.en: Art and education keep the older folder sense: an art portfolio and an assessment portfolio.
normal.cn: 艺术与教育保留了较早的文件夹义：作品集与学习档案。

abstract.en: Picture an open case of sheets, each sheet a different kind of claim.
abstract.cn: 想象一只打开的文件箱，每张纸都是不同种类的主张。

abstract.en: Picture the case shrinking until it is only the set of claims, no paper at all.
abstract.cn: 想象箱子不断缩小，最后只剩下那套主张，连纸也没有了。

abstract.en: Picture the same shape reappearing as a range of products or a bundle of duties.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个形状再次出现，成为一组产品或一束职责。

examples.en: A diversified portfolio can survive a single bad year.
examples.cn: 分散的投资组合能挺过单个糟糕年份。

examples.en: The designer revised her portfolio before the interview.
examples.cn: 设计师在面试前修改了作品集。

examples.en: He carried a leather portfolio under his arm.
examples.cn: 他腋下夹着一只皮制公文包。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「随身携带的一叠纸」——把各种资产像纸页一样装进同一只夹子 → 投资组合

root: 意大利语 portafoglio「装纸的提包」，由 portare「携带」（拉丁语 portare）与 foglio「纸页」（拉丁语 folium）构成；后由「携带的文件」引申为一人所持的一整套投资、作品或职责。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start from a case of sheets and end with any managed collection: investments, artworks, duties, student work, products and projects.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从一只装纸的提包出发，最终落在任何被管理的合集：投资、作品、职责、学生作业、产品与项目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open case of loose sheets, each sheet a different claim.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只打开的文件箱，散页各代表不同的主张。

branches.en: SET OF CLAIMS: the carried papers become a set of financial positions watched as one.
branches.cn: 一套主张：随身携带的纸变成一整套被整体关注的投资头寸。

branches.en: SET OF WORKS AND GOODS: art samples and product ranges are held together for display or balance.
branches.cn: 作品与商品合集：艺术样张与产品线被放在一起展示或平衡。

branches.en: THE CASE ITSELF: the literal object that every other sense borrows from.
branches.cn: 器物本身：其他所有义项都借用这个字面物件。

branches.en: OFFICE AND DUTIES: a bundle of state papers becomes the minister's office, then any range of responsibilities.
branches.cn: 职位与职责：一束公文先变成部长职位，再泛指任何职责范围。

branches.en: ASSESSED AND MANAGED SETS: a student's file and a project group are collections run as a whole.
branches.cn: 被评估与管理的合集：学生学习档案与项目群都是作为整体运营的合集。

intro.en: Portfolio is a borrowed Italian compound, and its parts remain visible in words about carrying and about sheets of paper.
intro.cn: portfolio 是借入的意大利语复合词，其组成部分在表示「携带」与「纸页」的词里仍然可见。

latinIntro.en: The two Latin sources are portare for carrying and folium for a leaf or sheet; both produced families of English words.
latinIntro.cn: 两个拉丁来源分别是表示携带的 portare 与表示树叶或纸页的 folium，两者都产生了英语词族。

items.example: He set the portfolio on the table.
The two portfolios overlap in energy.
items.exampleCN: 这两个组合在能源上重叠。

items.example: The bank ran a portfolio-wide review.

items.meaning: the person who runs a set of investments
items.example: The portfolio manager shifted into bonds.

items.meaning: grading based on a collected body of work
a leaf of paper or a large book format
items.example: The poem fills a single folio.
items.exampleCN: 这首诗占满一页对开纸。

items.meaningCN: 携带，如运输一词中的成分

items.meaning: a page or leaf in compounds
items.meaningCN: 复合词中表示纸页的成分
items.example: The suffix names a kind of page.
items.exampleCN: 这个成分表示某类纸页。

scene: 客人把大衣交给衣帽间的服务员。 The guests handed their coats to the cloakroom attendant.

senses.title: A room for coats and bags
senses.definition: a room where visitors leave coats and bags
senses.definitionCN: 访客存放外套与包袋的房间
senses.example: She left her umbrella in the cloakroom.
senses.exampleCN: 她把伞寄放在衣帽间。
senses.why: Cloak and room join to name the place for cloaks.
senses.whyCN: cloak 与 room 组合，指存放斗篷之处。

senses.title: A school coat room
senses.definition: a British school room where pupils hang coats
senses.definitionCN: 英国学校中学生挂外套的房间
senses.example: The children hung their coats in the cloakroom.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们把外套挂在学校的衣帽间。
senses.why: Schools used the same word for pupils coats.
senses.whyCN: 学校也用同一个词称呼学生外套处。

senses.title: A polite word for a toilet
senses.definition: a polite word for a public toilet, especially in Britain
senses.definitionCN: 英国尤其常用的卫生间委婉说法
senses.example: Excuse me, where is the cloakroom?
senses.exampleCN: 请问洗手间在哪里？
senses.why: The coat room became a euphemism for another room.

intro.en: Cloakroom joins a French cloak to an English room.
intro.cn: cloakroom 由法语「斗篷」与英语「房间」组成。

items.en: Cloque means a bell, the shape of a riding cloak.
items.cn: cloque 意为钟形，指骑马斗篷的形状。

items.en: English cloak names a loose outer garment.
items.cn: 十六世纪英语 cloak 指宽松外衣。

items.en: Railway stations open cloakrooms for luggage.
items.cn: 十九世纪火车站设衣帽间存放行李。

items.en: British schools call the coat room a cloakroom.
items.cn: 二十世纪英国学校称挂衣室为 cloakroom。

items.en: The word also serves as a polite word for a toilet.
items.cn: 现代该词也作卫生间的委婉说法。

note.en: The look-alike group is built from cloak; the near-meaning group names other storage rooms.

entries.definition: A loose outer coat.

entries.definition: A covered walk in a monastery.

entries.definition: A room where coats are checked.

normal.en: Cloak plus room.

normal.en: Hang your coat there.

normal.en: Keep the ticket safe.

normal.en: Schools have cloakrooms too.

normal.en: In Britain it can also mean the toilet.

abstract.en: Before the show, a small pause.

examples.en: He checked his briefcase at the cloakroom.
examples.cn: 他把公文包寄存在衣帽间。

examples.en: The cloakroom was crowded before the concert.
examples.cn: 音乐会前衣帽间很拥挤。

examples.en: Your cloakroom ticket is number forty-two.
examples.cn: 你的衣帽间号牌是四十二号。

dict_mnemonic.text: cloak（斗篷）+ room（房间）→ 放外套的房间，即衣帽间。

root: 法语 cloque（钟形斗篷）→ 英语 cloak（斗篷）+ room（房间）→ cloakroom

sensesIntro.en: A room for coats became a room for school bags and, politely, a toilet.
sensesIntro.cn: 放外套的房间，后来也放书包，还成了卫生间的委婉语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a row of hooks and coats behind a counter
core.cn: 核心意象：柜台后一排挂钩与外套

branches.en: Coats handed over at a theatre desk.
branches.cn: 剧院柜台前递出的大衣。

branches.en: A bag left for a museum visit.
branches.cn: 参观博物馆时寄存的包。

branches.en: Children hanging coats at school.
branches.cn: 在学校挂外套的孩子。

branches.en: A polite question in a restaurant.
branches.cn: 餐厅里的一句委婉询问。

branches.en: One word for coats kept at a place.
branches.cn: 在某个地方存放外套的同一个词。

intro.en: Cloakroom is a compound; the list adds words of storing and clothing.
intro.cn: cloakroom 是复合词；下面列出存放与衣物词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin clocca is a bell, vestis is a garment, and custos is a guard.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 clocca 意为钟，vestis 意为衣服，custos 意为看守。

latinEntries.exampleCN: clocca 产生 cloak 与 clock。
vestis 产生 vest 与 vestibule。
custos 产生 custody 与 custodian。
